mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates stronger economic activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and reduces equity risk premiums, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in INDPRO-based signal instances are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 2.5% signals imminent monetary tightening, which increases discount rates for equity valuations and reduces risk appetite, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 2.5%), or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.5% and employment growth (PAYEMS) falls below 138,000 persons, it indicates a deteriorating labor market, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (UNRATE > 5.5% AND PAYEMS < 138000) fails to produce negative returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 220), central banks are likely to tighten policy, compressing equity valuations and increasing risk aversion, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of high-inflation regime instances (CPIAUCSL > 220), or the regime's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 2.5% signals imminent monetary tightening, causing short-term equity volatility and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 2.5%), or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1000 and residential sales (RSAFS) decline below 380,000 million dollars, it indicates a contraction in the housing market, signaling broader economic weakness and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST < 1000 AND RSAFS < 380000) fails to produce negative returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 6%), equity markets anticipate reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 40% of high-unemployment regime instances (UNRATE > 6%), or the regime's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic activity, supporting corporate earnings and reducing equity risk, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in INDPRO-based signal instances are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
